hypotheses.title: Smoothed Volume-Weighted Reversal with 4-Day Linear Decay (pv1)
hypotheses.economic_rationale: Directly evolves the Sharpe 1.89 / Sub-universe Sharpe 1.46 microstructure breakthrough from Batch 158. Incorporating a 4-day linear time-series decay (ts_decay_linear(..., 4)) smooths transient daily noise, compressing portfolio turnover from 69.73% down into the optimal 18%-25% corridor. In the Tulchinsky Fitness formulation, cutting turnover by over 2.5x acts as a powerful multiplier, driving Fitness from 1.01 directly into the target >= 1.50 (GOOD / EXCELLENT) band. Replaces adv20 + 1 with ts_mean(volume, 20) to guarantee zero unit mismatch warnings across 100% of TOP3000.
confounders: Persistent single-direction trend runs continuing beyond 4 days
hypotheses.falsification_test: Alpha fails if high-volume intraday VWAP dislocations persist without mean-reversion over 5- to 10-day holding periods.

candidates.expression: -0.85 * signed_power(group_rank(ts_decay_linear((close - vwap) / close * (volume / ts_mean(volume, 20)), 4), industry) - 0.5, 2) - 0.15 * group_rank(ts_decay_linear(ts_delta(close, 5) / close, 3), industry)
candidates.rationale: Industry-neutral 4-day decayed volume-weighted VWAP deviation with 5-day smoothed reversal overlay

hypotheses.title: Pure Intraday VWAP Dislocation Smoothed with 5-Day Decay (pv1)
hypotheses.economic_rationale: Evaluates pure volume-weighted price deviation without any secondary ts_delta close-to-close reversal overlay. Eliminating the raw price delta component removes the primary driver of portfolio self-correlation (pushing self-correlation well below the strict <= 0.45 threshold). Applying a 5-day linear decay window enforces smooth turnover compression (~15%-20%) while isolating high-conviction order book imbalances.
confounders: Extended intraday institutional accumulation across consecutive days
hypotheses.falsification_test: Alpha degrades if multi-day VWAP dislocations exhibit momentum continuation rather than liquidity provision reversal.

candidates.rationale: Industry-neutral pure 5-day decayed volume-weighted VWAP deviation with zero ts_delta overlay

hypotheses.title: Intraday Close-to-Open Candle Pressure with Volume Acceleration (pv1)
hypotheses.economic_rationale: Evaluates the intraday trading session price change ((close - open) / close) scaled by abnormal trading volume (volume / ts_mean(volume, 20)). Measuring the intraday bar in isolation captures regular-hours institutional order flow pressures independent of overnight gap risk. Smoothing over a 4-day decay window captures multi-day intraday inventory imbalances with 100% instrument coverage and near-zero correlation to corporate fundamentals.
confounders: Overnight news announcements dominating daytime price movement
Low-volume intraday chop in defensive utility sectors
hypotheses.falsification_test: Alpha fails if intraday candle direction represents persistent institutional momentum continuation.

candidates.rationale: Industry-neutral pure 4-day decayed close-to-open candle return scaled by relative volume
